targets.label: Trader Joe's, Union Square
targets.description: The funny one. Relatable mark, absurd ambition. Audience always laughs.
targets.notes: Use this for all dry runs and as the fallback.json target. Best-tested output.

targets.label: Statue of Liberty, New York Harbor
targets.description: The iconic one. Big swing, cinematic scale. Judges love the audacity.
targets.notes: High style score guaranteed. Detroit's getaway is by water — agents should pick this up.

targets.label: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
targets.description: The absurd one. The most heist-appropriate building in the city. Audience expects it to be impossible.
targets.notes: Highest difficulty score. Professor should acknowledge the impossibility — plays well as comedy.

vetting_notes: All three targets tested against agent refusal guardrails. None trigger real-person or real-residential-address refusals. All produce flat-plan risk scores above 6.0. Federal Reserve may generate longer agent turns — watch the timing window.
